meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: 它把自己当向导,带新用户按顺序走六条线:功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值测算、全程记忆记录、首次会话的 init-deep 提议;其中三条可跳过。产出迁移方案、用量与缓存节省估算(标注为估算)。
howto.when: 当新用户说要开始用 omo 时触发。它一生只自动启动一次,之后可用 omo --onboard 或 senpi --onboard 唤回。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo,带我走一遍。
把我在 Claude Code 里的配置迁过来。
say.note: 它先给出迁移方案,等你确认才动手。

say.text: 看看我以前的会话,估一下能省多少。
say.note: 读旧会话日志后给出一条估算。

howto.what_en: Guides a new omo user's first conversation through six lanes (feature tour, migration, archaeology, value mapping, memory, init-deep proposal); three are opt-in. It outputs a migration plan and a labeled savings estimate.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once ever; users can bring it back with omo --onboard or senpi --onboard.

say_en.text: I want to start using omo — walk me through it.
Carry over my Claude Code setup.
say_en.note: It shows a migration plan and waits for your yes.

say_en.text: Look at my old sessions and estimate the savings.
say_en.note: It reads past session logs, then gives an estimate.
